findings.message:
Apply the shared cap to hosted admission

This changes only the local host configuration; the workflow change is reporting-only. The plan identifies GitHub Actions/hosted Sentinel as the runtime and calls the limit shared, but no hosted budget or cooldown authority is updated. Hosted execution can therefore continue enforcing the old one-start hourly cap while local reporting says 60. Update the hosted source of truth and its tests.

src/host/local.ts:232-232

Remove the superseded one-start instruction

The newly added policy sets the hourly cap to 60, but this still-operational paragraph says to use at most one start per rolling hour. Because this is the authoritative plan, readers can follow conflicting limits; rewrite it to 60 or explicitly mark it as historical.

MASTER-PLAN.md:30-31

summary: The new hourly cap is not propagated to the hosted admission path, and the authoritative plan retains a conflicting one-start instruction.
